turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Adrian. Rachel Lim speaking. Thanks for calling. Are you somewhere you can speak privately, and is the line reasonably clear on your side?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Morning, Rachel. Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. I've got a short gap between meetings, so let's keep this fairly concise, please.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. I'll keep us focused. For the identity check, please give your identification details and date of birth.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My NRIC is S six five three two five three nine A. My date of birth is the sixteenth of May nineteen ninety-eight.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. I have your account screen open. I'll let you speak first.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've got my notes here. The fund I want to transact in is Nova Technology Equity Fund. Please use euros as the transaction currency. The amount I am committing to this transaction is 1,000,000. I have 5,000 units in mind, but let me settle the details before committing to that quantity. My earlier investment in this fund was 150,000 euros. That's just my budgeting history, not the amount for today's instruction.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before we continue, For illustration only, a subscription of 100,000 euros would translate into units based on the applicable unit price. That example is not your current order amount. Nova Technology Equity Fund is concentrated in technology shares, so its value can swing sharply when sentiment towards that sector changes. Do you understand how that concentration in technology shares can cause sharp swings in the fund's value?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. A change in sentiment towards technology shares can make the fund's value fluctuate sharply.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You could lose part or even all of the money you invest in this fund. Are you willing to accept investment losses on this investment?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses and substantial fluctuations in value.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. While I complete the account administration, shall I keep telephone appointments as your preferred arrangement? You mentioned previously that branch visits are difficult to fit in.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, telephone is much easier. The consulting work has been very busy lately. Even when I'm in Singapore, my calendar fills up with client meetings quite quickly.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: No problem. For future appointment scheduling, would you prefer that I send a message first rather than call you without notice?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please message first. Then I can find a quiet slot instead of answering halfway through a meeting. That works better for me. For the final order, use the unit quantity I mentioned earlier. I'm committing to that quantity now. I want to buy, please. Please place a limit order with a limit price of 200 euros per unit.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: buy 5,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund, for an amount of 1,000,000 in euros, using a limit order at a limit price of 200 euros. Is that the instruction you want me to execute?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Please proceed exactly as you have stated.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. That's all I need from you on this call. I'll keep any follow-up communication on our usual channel, with a message before arranging another appointment.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Good, thanks for keeping it brief. I can get back to preparing for my next meeting now. Appreciate your help, Rachel.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You're welcome. I'll leave you to it. Have a good day, Adrian. Goodbye.
